《日日新闻》

米勒路武装劫匪活跃

米勒路上经常发生武装抢劫案。许多日本人居住在这条路上。这些是简单的抢劫案，还是反日行为？1月30日下午，一名中国人突然出现在米勒路788弄，用枪指着另一名在弄堂里行走的中国人。后者大声呼救，随后持枪中国人成功逃脱。受到持枪中国人威胁的那个人的外貌像日本人；持枪者显然把他误认为是日本人。
当天下午5点，五名武装劫匪袭击了米勒路25号世春里（Shh Chun Li），这是一处由中国人居住的房屋，抢走了77元现金。

《尼波报》（Nippo）

上海日本笔会成立

1月30日晚，几名日本人聚集在狄思威路公寓竹内（Takeuchi）先生家中，成立了上海笔会。这个新团体将每半年出版一期杂志，通过短篇小说、小说、诗歌和中国文学译作向日本人介绍中国。第一期将于2月底出版，售价每本1美元。北四川路的内山书店将担任代理。

中日和解

《尼波报》发表如下评论：—
由于日本目前的政治动荡和中国的西安事变，中日谈判目前陷入停滞。我们无法预测在日本新内阁组建以及南京解决西安事变后，中日关系将朝哪个方向发展。
在经济上，日本和中国应该更加接近。尽管中日之间存在政治争端，但一家中日火柴制造公司已经成立，并将于2月1日开始营业。这是因为中国实业家意识到，由于缺乏熟练工人和良好的管理，中国的工厂无法与在华的日本工厂竞争。中国实业家愿意与日本实业家合作，而不问政治事务。如果日本希望领导并与中国合作，这一点不容忽视。

pages.en:
February 1, 1937.

-2-

The Powers treat Japan better
than China because the judicial, financial and other
systems in Japan are better than those in China. It
is well known that China is learning many things from
Japan. Chinese are now suggesting that Japan should
abandon her ideas of superiority over China and conduct
negotiations with China on a basis of equality. It
seems that the Chinese people do not understand the
difference between the positions held by Japan and China.
To promote political and economic relations between the
two countries, the Chinese people should consider Japan's
position and accept Japan's advice. The fact that China
was once a powerful country can be of no help to her to-day.
Several years ago Dr. C. T. Wang, speaking in connection
with the Shantung problem, said it would be better to be
the slaves of white people than of the Japanese people.
This is an absurd idea. We hope that the Chinese
people will reflect and dismiss such wrong ideas in order
to improve the relations between the two peoples.

列强对待日本比对待中国好，因为日本的司法、金融和其他制度比中国的好。众所周知，中国正在向日本学习许多东西。中国人现在建议日本应放弃优于中国的观念，并在平等的基础上与中国进行谈判。看来中国人民并不理解日本和中国所处地位的差异。为了促进两国的政治和经济关系，中国人民应考虑日本的立场并接受日本的建议。中国曾经是一个强国这一事实对今天的她毫无帮助。几年前，王正廷博士在谈及山东问题时说，做白人的奴隶比做日本人的奴隶要好。这是一个荒谬的想法。我们希望中国人民反思并摒弃这些错误观念，以改善两国人民之间的关系。

JAPANESE AMALGAMATED ASSOCIATION OF STREET UNIONS
TO HOLD A MEETING.

The Japanese Amalgamated
Association of Street Unions has decided to hold a
meeting at 4.30 p.m. October 7 in order to discuss
the suggestion of the S.M.C. to the effect that special
plates be fixed out side Japanese residences in order
to distinguish them from Chinese, thus preventing a repetition
of illegal entry by police.

JAPANESE CONSULAR POLICE KEEPS SHARP WATCH ON
UNRULY ELEMENTS.

It is reported that the local
Japanese Consular Police are keeping a sharp watch on
the movements of Korean malcontents, as they might make
an attempt to create disturbances in Japan during the
grand military manoeuvres in November.

MAINICHI

CHINESE ECONOMIC TOURIST PARTY ENTERTAINS JAPANESE
NEWSPAPER REPORTERS.

The Chinese economic tourist
party to Japan, which consists of a number of important
Chinese officials in Tientsin, Canton and Shanghai,
entertained reporters of the local Japanese newspapers
in the Park Hotel on Bubbling Well Road at noon yesterday.
Mr. Wu, the head of the party,
delivered a speech in the course of which he stated that
the party would represent the wishes of the Chinese
people and that the visit was being made for the purpose
of inspecting the industrial and economic progress made
by Japan. They would exchange opinions with economic
circles in order to realize a Sino-Japanese economic
co-operation. This would be the mission of his party.
He further expressed the hope that the reporters would
give every possible assistance.
The party consists of 32 members
and will leave Shanghai at 9 a.m. to-day on the S.S.
Shanghai Maru.

JAPANESE Y.M.C.A TO ESTABLISH A JAPANESE LANGUAGE
SCHOOL FOR CHINESE.

Japanese Y.M.C.A. has decided to establish a Japanese
language school for Chinese at No. 18 Ki Min Lee, North
Szochuen Road on October 11.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, OCTOBER 4, 1935

LOCAL MERCHANTS
GOING TO JAPAN
——
Warm Welcome Arranged for
Chinese Mission

Tokyo, Oct. 3.
Preparations were rushed to-day by various industrial and official bodies for a grand reception for the Chinese Economic Mission, which is leaving Shanghai for Japan on October 6 in the ss. Shanghai Maru.
The mission, including more than a score of China's leading merchants, bankers and industrialists, is headed by Mr. Wu Ta-chuan, of the Salt Industrial Bank. Among the organizations represented are the Bank of China, the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, the Kincheng Banking Corporation, the Bank of Communications, the China Merchants' Steam Navigation Co. and the Shanghai and Hankow Chambers of Commerce.
An elaborate programme, including a tea party given by Mr. K. Hirota, the Foreign Minister, and a dinner by Baron Kishichiro Okura, head of the Okura interests, has been prepared by the Sino-Japanese Business Association.
Various business and industrial organizations have also made arrangements to meet the visitors for exchanges of views on economic relations between the two countries. These include the Japan Economic Federation, the Japan Industrial Club, the Japan Foreign Trade Association and the Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
Members of the Mission will conclude their stay in Tokyo on Oct. 14 with a luncheon given by Mr. M. Shigemitsu, Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs, who was formerly Japanese Minister to China, and a tea party by Mr. R. Fujiyama, member of the House of Peers and president of the firm bearing his name. They will leave here for Osaka in the evening, remaining there until October 21, when they will return to Tokyo.—Rengo.
Entertained by Dr. Kung
The members of the Mission were entertained at a tiffin given by Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance, yesterday. A farewell dinner has also been arranged for to-morrow evening at the Park Hotel by six local public bodies, including the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and the Bankers Association.

《字林西报》，1935年10月4日，星期五

本地商人
赴日
——
为中国代表团安排热烈欢迎

东京，10月3日。
各工业界和官方机构今日加紧筹备，以隆重接待将于10月6日乘坐“上海丸”轮从上海启程赴日的中国经济代表团。
该代表团由中国二十多位主要商人、银行家和实业家组成，由盐业银行的吴达铨先生率领。代表的机构包括中国银行、上海商业储蓄银行、金城银行、交通银行、轮船招商局以及上海和汉口总商会。
中日商务协会已准备了详尽的日程，包括外相广田弘毅先生举行的茶会和奥村男爵（大仓财阀首领）举行的晚宴。
各类商业和工业组织也安排了与访客会面，就两国间的经济关系交换意见。这些组织包括日本经济联盟、日本工业俱乐部、日本对外贸易协会以及日本商工会议所。
代表团成员将于10月14日结束在东京的行程，届时将参加前日本驻华公使、现任外务次官重光葵先生举行的午餐会，以及贵族院议员、藤山财团总裁藤山雷太先生举行的茶会。他们将于当晚由此前往大阪，停留至10月21日，随后返回东京。——联合通讯社。
